summary: Design price offers, charging units and package tiers; run pricing experiments and compare eligible pricing cohorts, contribution margin, and renewal effects.
triggers: pricing model and value unit selection
price tier and package redesign experiments
pricing experiments with eligible offer cohorts
discount expiry and renewal pricing rollout
antiTriggers: prospect qualification or account scoring for buying intent
